description.name: Entry
description.text:
Grants [Tactical Awoken Mode], [Tactical Awoken Mode: Noctis], ATK +500 to user
TP Max: AOE Fire/NE, Earth/NE, or Lightning/NE physical attack at True Cap Break Level 1

description.name: Tactical Awoken Mode
description.text: Keeps track of TP level (0~6), increases TP level by 1 when the character is hit by a damaging attack or an ally uses a damaging action, casts a certain ability when TP level reaches 6. Removed after 8 abilities.

description.name: Tactical Awoken Mode: Noctis
description.text: Fire, Lightning or Earth abilities deal 30% more damage, have +10000 damage cap, deal 5/10/15/20/30% more damage at ability rank 1/2/3/4/5, trigger 2 additional times and don't consume ability uses, Fire, Lightning or Earth abilities ignore 20% of the target's DEF and RES, keeps track of the number of Fire, Lightning or Earth abilities used, removes [Tactical Awoken Mode] after using 8 Fire, Lightning or Earth abilities, removed if the user hasn't [Tactical Awoken Mode]

description.name: Weapon Skill
description.text: Single-target Fire/Earth/Lightning/NE piercing physical attack at True Cap Break Level 1, grants [Instant ATB 1] & [Instant Cast 1] to user; during [Tactical Awoken Mode], Cap Break Level 2 & 30% DEF/RES Pierce to Fire/Earth/Lightning Abilities; Critical Chance +100% & Critical Damage +50% to user / during [Tactical Awoken Mode], Fire/Earth/Lightning Ability Damage +50% & chases a Fire/Earth/Lightning ability with [200% ATB 2] to user (max 1 chase) at 0/100% Critical Chance
